title: Structured trace-replay + callout-template runner for on-call diagnostic sessions
author: Asha Desai
body:
Motivation: On-call rotations often require reconstructing a short lived diagnostic session (logs, traces, selected metrics, and the sequence of investigation steps) so that a responder can replay and validate mitigations without having to re-run noisy or expensive data pulls. This PR adds a lightweight "trace-replay" component and a small templating runner for scripted callouts (actions that suggest the next steps to responders). The implementation focuses on: compact, auditable session manifests, safe dry-run execution, and an embeddable UI player for post-incident review.

What this PR does (high level):
- Introduces a session manifest format (JSON) that packages an ordered list of diagnostic artifacts (trace snippets, metric snapshots, logs pointers, and recommended CLI commands).
- Adds a trace-replay service that can reconstruct a timeline view and step through artifacts in the web UI; supports playback speed, step annotations, and jump-to-event.
- Adds callout templates (YAML) and a runner that renders templates with session context and can enqueue human-facing notifications (Slack/Email) or show inline suggestions in the player.
- Adds server-side validation and a safe-execution mode: callout runner supports only whitelisted action types and will never execute destructive commands in non-admin contexts.
- Adds unit + integration tests, and a small docs page with usage and example manifests.

Checklist: 
- [x] Design doc linked (Linear ENG-1124).
- [x] Session manifest schema stable (v1).
- [x] Safe runner mode & whitelist implemented.
- [x] Tests for replay logic + template rendering.
- [x] UI player with keyboard controls.

Usage notes: To create a replayable session, produce a manifest (examples/docs/trace-replay.md). Upload via the incident-bot API (POST /v1/sessions) or attach to an incident. The player can be opened from the incident timeline and supports exporting the manifest for offline review. Callout templates live under src/templates and can be previewed in the UI.

Security & operational constraints:
- Callout templates are evaluated server-side but only support safe rendering variables and pre-approved delivery channels.
- The runner includes a dry-run flag to prevent accidental side-effects during drills.
- Session manifests do not store raw sensitive logs by default; they point to redacted storage locations. Users must opt into full log capture and provide consent.

Related changes and links: Linear ENG-1124; SRE-73. Design notes: ./docs/design/trace-replay.md. Demo recording: internal link to recording.

Migration: This is backward compatible. Old incidents without manifests are unaffected. The manifest schema includes a version field for future migration.

Rollout plan: feature gated behind `trace_replay.enabled` config flag. Enable in staging, run warm-up traffic, then flip for small oncall group before broader rollout.

review_comments: Marek Novak (reviewer): Overall looks good. Two concerns: 1) whitelist maintenance model for callout actions; 2) ensure manifest pointers never leak S3 credentials. Can we centralize the whitelist in pkg/config and add an automated alert when new action types are added?

Asha Desai (author): Answered - moved whitelist into pkg/config and added a small CI check that fails when new action types are introduced without a corresponding config entry. Also updated docs to explicitly state we only store pointer metadata (no credentials).

Jordan Li (reviewer): Suggested improving test coverage around race conditions in the timeline stepping (rapid forward/back). Added a small integration test that simulates concurrent step commands. CI showed a timing flake, I tuned the backoff in the player code.

Sofia Martínez (reviewer): UX nit: keyboard shortcut should use 'n'/'p' instead of arrow keys for accessibility. Also requested that callout preview render sanitized markdown. Made both changes and added automated sanitizer in the renderer.
Marek Novak (approver): Approved after changes. Ran a manual end-to-end in staging; player worked and callout dry-run mode prevented side effects.

merge_outcome: Merged via squash merge by Marek Novak on 2026-02-24. Merge commit message: "feat(incident-bot): structured trace-replay and callout runner (ENG-1124)"
release_notes: Adds a replayable diagnostic session manifest and embeddable player in the incident timeline. Introduces safe callout templates with a server-side runner and whitelist enforcement. Feature is gated behind the trace_replay.enabled config flag.
